note: The Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands is part of the United States for the nationality law (8 U.S.C. 1101(a)(38)), so a person born there is a citizen at birth (8 U.S.C. 1401(a)) and its rules are the United States'.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1101 Definitions
sources.said: (29) The term "outlying possessions of the United States" means American Samoa and Swains Island. ... (38) The term "United States", except as otherwise specifically herein provided, when used in a geographical sense, means the continental United States, Alaska, Hawaii, Puerto Rico, Guam, the Virgin Islands of the United States, and the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands.

sources.title: U.S. Code (2023 edition, GPO govinfo), Title 8, § 1401 Nationals and citizens of United States at birth
sources.said: The following shall be nationals and citizens of the United States at birth: (a) a person born in the United States, and subject to the jurisdiction thereof;
